modalities.evidence: a single anatomical image per participant
two behavioural cognitive tasks at three time-points

output.population: 60 healthy individuals, ages 18–24, divided into Braille training, Music training and Control groups
output.summary: Longitudinal behavioural and preprocessed neuroimaging data on learning-related plasticity in young adults split into Braille training, piano training and control groups, with anatomical imaging, resting-state and task fMRI, n-back and Stroop tasks.
